question: Which architect has designed the India Gate in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Edwin Lutyens**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sir Edwin Lutyens,** an Englishman who constructed various other war memorials and was also the chief planner of New Delhi, was the architect.
 
• The duke of Connaught, Queen Victoria's third son, lay the cornerstone in 1921.
 
• The construction of the All-India War Memorial, as it was originally known, lasted until **1931**, the year **New Delhi was formally designated as India's capital**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sir Edwin Landseer Lutyens** was an English architect who was noted for altering classic architectural styles to meet the needs of his day.
 
• **Le Corbusier** was a Swiss-French architect, designer, painter, urban planner, and writer who is widely considered one of the forefathers of modern architecture. Chandigarh, the dream city of India's first Prime Minister, Sh. Jawahar Lal Nehru was planned by **Le Corbusier. **
 
• **Albert Speer **was a German architect who served as Nazi Germany's Minister of Armaments and War Production throughout the majority of WWII.
 
• **Lawrence Wilfred "Laurie" Baker** was a British-born Indian architect who was known for pioneering cost-effective, energy-efficient architecture and designs that maximized space, ventilation, and light while maintaining a clean, striking aesthetic sensibility.
